title: Design System: Mohanad Yehia Software QA Portfolio

display.purpose: Desktop Pass Through headline, with the documented flowing compact clamps and rem-based lower bound for enlarged text.

headline.purpose: Representative section heading from the approach; other editorial surfaces use the documented optical size adjustments.

title.purpose: Approach-step heading; archive framework headings use the nearby documented clamp.

body.purpose: Ordinary page copy and the inherited reading base for controls.

body-reading.purpose: Long-form case-study prose in the reading column capped at 47rem.

label.purpose: Supporting metadata, captions, and evidence context below headings.

action.purpose: Desktop Pass Through actions, with padded flowing controls below 1024px and the compact 600px variant.

motion.name: action-state-duration
motion.purpose: Background and color changes in opening actions, navigation, and the contact email.

motion.name: arrow-and-disclosure-duration
motion.purpose: Editorial link arrows and experience-disclosure plus rotation.

motion.name: opening-scrub
motion.purpose: Native-scroll catch-up for the shared Pass Through opening; its choreography uses relative timeline units rather than a fixed playback duration.

motion.name: content-entrance
motion.purpose: Once-only shared entrance at top 92%; already-visible or revealed content stays steady and completed transform, opacity, and clip styles clear.

motion.name: content-entrance-opacity
motion.purpose: Noninteractive waiting groups may fade from zero without visibility hiding. Linked groups remain fully opaque and use transforms alone.

motion.name: content-entrance-displacement
motion.purpose: Shared vertical entrance for below-viewport data-reveal groups, including transform-only linked groups.

motion.name: entrance-ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for shared once-only entrances.

motion.name: heading-reveal-displacement
motion.purpose: Shared chapter, case-prose, and evidence heading entrance; headings containing controls use translation alone.

motion.name: heading-reveal-mask
motion.purpose: Initial mask only for shared heading entrances without links or controls; cleared when the entrance completes.

motion.name: material-and-portrait-scrub
motion.purpose: Catch-up for the opposing upper/lower material travel and the real portrait settle, over their separate source ranges.

motion.name: diagram-and-trace-scrub
motion.purpose: Catch-up for Cal.diy contention bars, the LLM agreement treatment, and the production trace; each retains its own content range.

motion.name: ambient-light-scrub
motion.purpose: Bounded warm/silver light change from document start to max scroll; no idle loop.

motion.name: evidence-rule-entrance
motion.purpose: Once-only scaleX reveal of case evidence rules.

motion.name: recorded-observation-entrance
motion.purpose: TestPulse recorded observations enter once at top 85% with expo.out when not already at the reading position.

motion.name: recorded-observation-stagger
motion.purpose: Spacing between the shared opening component's recorded observations.

motion.name: document-group-duration
motion.purpose: Native document-transition group timing, including matching project names across the homepage, archive, cases, and next-case links.

motion.name: document-exit-duration
motion.purpose: Root page-out transition to zero opacity and translateY(-8px), using ease-out.

motion.name: document-entry-duration
motion.purpose: Root page-in transition from zero opacity and translateY(12px).

motion.name: document-entry-ease
motion.purpose: Native transition groups and root page-in easing.

motion.name: scene-entry-settle
motion.purpose: Initial 3D activation waits for settled scrolling within its observation area; exit or hidden document restores static artwork.

motion.name: opening-resize-settle
motion.purpose: Opening window/stage resize debounce before geometry, reading-position restoration, and the shared layout event.

motion.name: reduced-motion-duration
motion.purpose: Global reduced-motion animation and transition duration; scrolling becomes immediate and native document transitions opt out.

narrative.overview:
Matte graphite makes room for warm white typography, quiet controls, and precisely lit inspection materials. The system pairs an exhibition's large visual statements with a monograph's patient reading rhythm. Offset dark chrome and transparent amber layers give the abstract subject a physical form.

Editorial layouts vary with their content: open project entries, ruled framework rows, attributed numerical evidence, long-form reading columns, and the owner's real portrait. Conceptual imagery is identified as artwork. Readable text and controls stay in HTML, with a complete static experience beneath optional motion and 3D. The accepted Pass Through opening now leads the homepage; its continuous project arrival extends into content-specific chapter motion, material-framed case entrances, and a quiet reading body.
keyCharacteristics: Matte graphite, warm white, and a controlled amber accent.
Alexandria display typography paired with Manrope reading text.
Rectangular editorial surfaces, fine rules, and generous section spacing.
Optical depth carried by actual inspection materials and the local live study.
Bounded native-scroll choreography, with steady prose and direct actions.
Semantic controls, visible focus, and complete static alternatives.

rules.name: The Controlled Light Rule
rules.body: Amber identifies illumination, emphasis, or an interactive state; graphite and warm neutrals retain the largest visual fields.

rules.name: The Evidence State Rule
rules.body: Results retain readable words and scope alongside color. The light Cal.diy audit uses its observed retained-failure red locally; that one evidence treatment does not add a global accent family.

rules.name: The Reading Contrast Rule
rules.body: Warm White carries headings and strong emphasis; Reading Stone carries sustained dark-surface prose; Muted Stone carries secondary context.

rules.name: The Optical Scale Rule
rules.body: Use the observed role and responsive behavior for the surface. This implementation has optical size adjustments, not one universal modular type ratio.

rules.name: The Material Depth Rule
rules.body: Reserve optical richness for the inspection object; keep reading surfaces and controls structurally clear with tone and rules.

rules.name: The Complete Still Rule
rules.body: Artwork and content remain complete before enhancement. Demand-rendered 3D updates on pointer, layer-control, or scroll changes and yields to the static artwork outside its supported conditions.

dos: Do use graphite and warm neutrals as the largest fields, with amber carrying illumination or useful state.
Do use the actual Alexandria and Manrope families and preserve the distinction between display, reading, and supporting text.
Do vary editorial structure with the content, using ruled rows, reading columns, and evidence panels where they serve the material.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, readable selected states, semantic controls, and a complete static composition.
Do keep the real portrait and identify conceptual inspection imagery as artwork.
Do keep result labels, numerical scope, and evidence limitations readable beside their visual emphasis.
donts: Don't extend the approved Selected work label into a new system of decorative eyebrows or arbitrary indices.
Don't replace the inspection materials with generic glowing objects or fake report interfaces.
Don't add elevated shadows to reading panels or turn the varied editorial content into one repeated card template.
Don't use amber alone to communicate a result or selected state.
Don't require animation, WebGL, or clipboard support to reach the content, resume, or contact information.
Don't treat synthesized preview tonal ramps as source tokens or approved new surface colors.
